$comment: The duplication counting rule, and the suppressed lines declared per population.
Spec: docs/spec/static-analysis-and-style.md §5. Decision: docs/adr/0072-a-clone-is-a-relation-between-two-places.md.
THIS FILE IS `stryker.floors.json`'s TWIN FOR THE SECOND TOOL, AND IT IS A SEPARATE
FILE FOR TWO STRUCTURAL REASONS RATHER THAN BY PREFERENCE.
1. `correspondence()` in scripts/lib/floors.ts compares that file's scope keys against
the DECLARED MUTATION SCOPES, in both directions, and refuses the deploy on a
mismatch. The whole-tree population is not a mutation scope and never will be, so a
key for it in that file is a refusal on every deploy from the day it lands.
2. `parseCaps()` treats any cap name that is not `complexity-max` or
`complexity-mass-over-10` as a PARSE ERROR, on purpose — a typo must not read as
protection. That parser is therefore hostile to every duplication entry by design,
and loosening it to admit these would remove the guard for the complexity caps too.
NINE, NOT EIGHT. The eight declared scopes from stryker.scopes.json, plus `whole-tree`.
A CLONE IS A RELATION BETWEEN TWO PLACES, and a relation does not partition into scopes:
eight per-scope numbers are structurally blind to a clone whose halves sit in two of
them, and `gates/` is read by no scope at all. The whole-tree population is TypeScript
only and no scope list can shrink it. Measured: over EVERY file jscpd reports 1042
duplicated lines, 570 of them JSON this repo did not write — cached provider responses
and a provisioned dashboard, two O'Reilly fixtures sharing 105 identical lines because
one book returns from two endpoints. A RECORDED RESPONSE CANNOT BE DE-DUPLICATED WITHOUT
FALSIFYING THE FIXTURE, so the restriction to TypeScript is a measurement and not taste.
Lines inside a `jscpd` suppression block in this population's source, BOTH DIRECTIVE
LINES INCLUDED. Asserted against a real sweep of the tree by gates/ignored-clones.test.ts,
AT MERGE — G43's surface and G43's reason: `main-protection` carries
`required_approving_review_count: 0`, so the gate suite and CodeQL are the only two
things that can stop a merge.
WHY IT IS DECLARED AT ALL. Measured, jscpd 5.0.16: a suppression block removes its lines
FROM THE CLONE COUNT AND FROM THE TOTAL-LINE DENOMINATOR TOGETHER — 34 raw lines with a
12-line block report 20 — so the percentage does not move, the clone count falls, and
NOTHING ANYWHERE SAYS A SUPPRESSION HAPPENED. That is G38's failure shape and G43's
directive shape in one comment. With the count declared here, adding a block costs a
visible diff in a file review reads, and omitting the declaration reddens at merge.
THERE ARE ZERO IN THIS REPOSITORY, so any increase is a real event.
ONLY ONE SPELLING IS PERMITTED — a whole-line `//` comment. jscpd honours four forms and
removes A DIFFERENT SPAN for each: measured at twelve live lines and three hidden ones,
the whole-line form removes 5, a `/** … */` block carrying the word on its continuation
line removes 9, and a directive trailing after code removes 4. A counter that picked one
arithmetic would be wrong about the other two while looking right, so the sweep DETECTS
all four and REFUSES three. See scripts/lib/duplication.ts.
⚠️ THE COUNTER RECORDS WHAT THE SOURCE DECLARES, NOT WHAT JSCPD REMOVED, AND THE TWO ARE
NOT THE SAME NUMBER. Measured this session at fourteen live lines and a three-line block,
varying only what follows the closing directive: with the block ending the file jscpd
removes 5; with a blank line or a comment after it, 6 — the block AND the trailing line;
WITH ONE LINE OF CODE AFTER IT, 0. A SUPPRESSION BLOCK IN THE MIDDLE OF A FILE DOES
NOTHING, SILENTLY. Where it is honoured it truncates to end of file rather than stopping
at the closing directive, so it can take more than the block as well.
Every earlier measurement of this feature — this repository's and #237's alike — put the
block at the end of a file, so all of them agreed and all of them were the special case.
The general shape was found by planting a block into a real file and comparing the two
numbers, which is the argument for a declared counter rather than an inferred one: a
block is an INTENT to take code out of a measurement, and the intent belongs in a diff
whether or not the tool acts on it. CONSEQUENCE, STATED PLAINLY: `totalLines +
ignoredLines` is an approximation and NOT an identity. Pinned by two cases in
scripts/lib/duplication.test.ts, so a jscpd that fixes this goes red rather than moving
eight series at once with nothing to point at.
`notes`  APPEND-ONLY, one line per block added, never cleared — stryker.floors.json's
rule and its reason. A bare number going 0 to 14 is a diff that says nothing
about why; the justification belongs next to the permission, permanently.
Nothing enforces this. The file makes an omission visible, not impossible.
The counting rule these numbers were produced under: the jscpd version AS INSTALLED, and
its three thresholds, hashed in that order. SEPARATE FROM `fixtureHash` DELIBERATELY —
jscpd reads no ESLint version and ESLint reads no token threshold, so one hash over both
would make an ESLint upgrade refuse every duplication record and a jscpd upgrade refuse
every complexity record, in each case over a number that did not move.
WITHOUT THE PIN THESE COUNTS ARE NOT COMPARABLE TO THEIR OWN PAST: #232 measured 12
clones at 50/5 and 82 at 20/3 OVER THE IDENTICAL TREE. A threshold is not a setting
around the number; it is the number.
── no caps, and that is this ticket's instruction rather than an omission ─────────
NO CAP LIVES HERE YET AND NO NAME JOINS `CAPPED_SERIES`. Six of the eight duplication
series are to be capped — the spec's §5 says which — but `countedIn` in
scripts/lib/floors.ts filters to records where EVERY member of `CAPPED_SERIES` has
samples, keyed on the whole set on purpose. Adding a name before twenty records carry
its samples makes every existing record on the `metrics` branch fail that filter at
once, ZEROING BOTH CYCLOMATIC CALIBRATION WINDOWS. Waiting costs nothing, because
`countedIn` reads what a record carries rather than what a type declares. That step is
https://github.com/mephistopheles4/stacks/issues/258, and it may not be folded in here.
